args:
headers=/tmp/headers
body=/tmp/body
# --retry-connrefused because the Service can be Ready before
# kube-proxy has programmed it, and a refused connection returns
# INSTANTLY, so --connect-timeout never applies (wamn-0h0g.15.137.14).
status=$(curl --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 \
  --retry 15 --retry-delay 1 --retry-connrefused \
  --dump-header "$headers" --output "$body" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
  --header 'Host: receiving.localhost' \
  'http://flow-http.wamn-receiving-journey.svc.cluster.local/no-such-route')
content_type=$(sed -n 's/^[Cc]ontent-[Tt]ype:[[:space:]]*//p' "$headers" \
  | tr -d '\r' | head -n 1)
test "$status" = 404
test "$content_type" = application/json
printf '%s' '{"error":{"code":"route-not-found"}}' >/tmp/expected
cmp -s /tmp/expected "$body"
printf '%s\n' 'RECEIVING_HTTP_PROBE {"status":404,"content_type":"application/json","host":"receiving.localhost","body":{"error":{"code":"route-not-found"}}}'
containers.name: probe

args:
update_status=$(curl --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 60                 --output /tmp/update.json --write-out '%{http_code}'                 --header 'Host: receiving.localhost'                 --header 'Content-Type: application/json'                 --header "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_CALLER_PAT"                 --header 'traceparent: 00-7c7fffcc1f0bdc78075b00432e0bd5fb-1111111111111111-01'                 --data '[{"request_id":"materializer-order","id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000304","expected_row_version":"1","change":{"acme_inspection_required":true,"acme_quality_status":"pending"}}]'                 'http://flow-http.wamn-receiving-journey.svc.cluster.local/acme/purchase_order/update')
test "$update_status" = 200
receipt_status=$(curl --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 60                 --output /tmp/receipt.json --write-out '%{http_code}'                 --header 'Host: receiving.localhost'                 --header 'Content-Type: application/json'                 --header "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_CALLER_PAT"                 --header 'traceparent: 00-0afc06d223c86c9e7718e8b2652e0c14-2222222222222222-01'                 --data '[{"request_id":"materializer-receipt","value":{"idempotency_key":"materializer-receipt-command","purchase_order_id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000304","receipt_reference":"MATERIALIZER-RECEIPT","occurred_at":"2026-08-31T12:34:00.000000Z","line":[{"purchase_order_line_id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000504","quantity":"9.0000","location_id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000201"}]}}]'                 'http://flow-http.wamn-receiving-journey.svc.cluster.local/acme/receiving/record_receipt')
test "$receipt_status" = 200
printf 'RECEIVING_MATERIALIZER_UPDATE '
tr -d '\n' </tmp/update.json
printf '\nRECEIVING_MATERIALIZER_RECEIPT '
tr -d '\n' </tmp/receipt.json
printf '\n'
containers.name: trigger

args:
set -eu
start=$(date +%s)
while [ $(($(date +%s) - start)) -lt 840 ]; do
  : >/tmp/body
  rc=0
  metrics=$(curl --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 \
    --output /tmp/body --write-out '%{http_code} %{content_type} %{time_total}' \
    --header "Host: $ROUTE_HOST" --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_CALLER_PAT" --data "$REQUEST_BODY" "$ENDPOINT") || rc=$?
  status=$(printf '%s' "$metrics" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  ctype=$(printf '%s' "$metrics" | cut -d' ' -f2 | tr -d ' ')
  elapsed=$(printf '%s' "$metrics" | awk '{print $NF}')
  printf 'WAMN_OPERATOR_SAMPLE %s %s %s %s %s %s\n' "$(date +%s)" "${status:-000}" "$rc" "${ctype:--}" "${elapsed:-0}" "$(base64 -w0 </tmp/body)"
  sleep 5
done
containers.name: probe
